title: openai-image-gen/prompt-generator output
description: Output returned by the prompt submission tool. The tool normalizes the prompt and emits the fixed openai-image.generate.requested event, so the model never constructs the event envelope itself.

prompt.description: Normalized final image prompt. Structured prompts are serialized by the submission tool.

promptMode.description: Output style. text=natural-language prompt; image-json=structured JSON-as-string.

composition.description: Picture composition mode copied from runtime settings and forwarded for tracing.

events.description: The submission tool emits exactly one event that wakes the image-generator follower.
